highlights: Anker Soundcore Rave 3S AI Party Speaker with 2 Wireless Microphones, 200W Sound, AI Vocal Removal, Reverb, Light Show, 12H Playtime, Portable Bluetooth PA System for Home, Party, or Backyard

AI-Driven Party Speaker: Feel powerful sound fill every corner, while dynamic lights bring the dance floor to life. With dual pro mics and AI vocal removal, singing your favorite songs has never been easier.

200W Powerful Sound: Enjoy booming 200W sound and deep bass via a 6.5" woofer and three 2.5" full-range drivers. This party speaker is loud enough to fill a basketball court, delivering the ultimate party atmosphere for any occasion.
Immersive Beat-Synced Light Show: Transform your home or backyard into a vibrant party space, and customize the light effects to set the perfect mood and match any vibe.
Dual Wireless Microphones: Own every duet with crystal-clear vocals and built-in volume and vocal removal controls.

AI Vocal Removal: Turn any gathering into a karaoke party with one click. Choose any song from any app, and AI removes the original vocals in real time. Adjust vocal levels to sing along or go full solo—your voice, your stage!
App Customization: The soundcore app gives you full control over your party speaker. Easily adjust EQ settings, lighting, vocal effects, and reverb.
Special Feature   AI Karaoke, Bass Boost, LED Light, Stereo Pairing, bluetooth microphone
